subject: fix: give scroll regions a tab stop
defect: Scrollable containers in the library and in the docs chrome had no tab stop, so a keyboard user could not scroll them: axe-core reports them under scrollable-region-focusable, and in Safari the Tab sequence walks straight past them.

method.chrome: Each page is loaded, walked top to bottom in 600 px steps (700 ms per step) so every lazily mounted preview renders and every streaming demo settles, then scrolled back to the top. axe-core 4.13.0 from the audit harness is injected and run over the whole document with runOnly tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and best-practice. Recorded: the node count and target selectors of the scrollable-region-focusable rule.
method.safari: For each scroll region, the preview root is scrolled so its top sits 96 px below the viewport top, its top-left padding is clicked at (root.left + 6, 102) to set WebKit's focus-navigation starting point, then Tab is pressed 8 times and document.activeElement is read after each press. A step counts as a scroll region when the focused element carries an overflow-auto / overflow-scroll class and is not a natively focusable control.

deviationsFromExpectation: The expected axe count was 12 violating nodes before the fix; the measurement finds 7, and 0 after. The three pages that contribute nothing are explained below, and none of them contradicts the fix.
Pull to refresh: its scroller does not overflow at 1440x900, so there is nothing for axe to flag in either build. The tab stop the PR adds is unconditional, and Safari does reach it after the fix.

Agent activity: none of the six demos caps its viewport at 1440x900, so the element stays overflow-y-hidden and the PR's tab stop (gated on capped && expanded && !working) never applies. No axe violation before or after, and the only region Safari reaches on that page is the docs install command box.

The docs install command box: the install command fits the card at 1440x900, so the box does not scroll and axe does not flag it. It still gets its tab stop after the fix, which the Safari walk shows on every page.

The table page's data preview is not flagged either: that scroller contains 33 focusable descendants (sort buttons, row inputs), and the axe rule exempts a scrollable region whose content is reachable by keyboard. The async preview on the same page has no focusable content and is flagged.
